claims.claim: The 25th Seoul International Cafe Show is scheduled for Nov 11-14, 2026 at COEX, all exhibition halls.
Nov 11-12 are business days, Nov 13-14 public days; Friday closes at 18:00, Saturday at 16:00, with last entry 30 minutes before closing.
COEX lists admission at 25,000 KRW for one day and 50,000 KRW for multiple days; ticket and event changes should be rechecked with the organizer.

sources.title: 제25회 서울카페쇼
sources.body: COEX event listing: Nov 11-14, 2026, all halls. Nov 11-12 10:00-18:00 business days; Nov 13 10:00-18:00 public day; Nov 14 10:00-16:00 public day; last entry 30 minutes before closing. One-day ticket 25,000 won; multi-day ticket 50,000 won. Exhibits include coffee, tea, bakery, raw materials, desserts, ice cream, chocolate, drinks/alcohol, equipment, interior, franchises/startup, kitchen appliances and foodservice business.

sources.title: The 25th Seoul Int’l Cafe Show
sources.body: Official English COEX page confirms Nov 11-14 dates, business/public day split, operating times, and listed admission.

sources.title: Seoul International Cafe Show
sources.body: Official event organizer website, event overview and registration destination. Visit before travel for latest admission and exhibitor updates.

cannotSay: Do not call the event free; COEX lists paid admission.
Do not describe every day as open to the general public; the first two are business days.
No attendee numbers, booth count, shuttle, ticket inventory, or parking guarantee without an official current notice.
